paths.description: Homepage and discovery feed; covers first impression, navigation, content cards, responsive layout and load behaviour.
Library/search listing archetype; covers filtering, responsive cards and browse task.
Representative title detail; covers content metadata and route from discovery into chapter selection.
Representative core reading flow; covers chapter rendering, navigation, ads and long-form media.
Authentication form archetype; covers labels, autocomplete, native validation and account access.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette is not connected to the user’s colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: DOM computed styles report color-scheme: normal, no relevant preference CSS was found, and normal/dark screenshots are byte-identical.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark tokens with prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route changes swap abruptly without a transition.
findings.evidence: CSS/runtime probe found no view-transition rules while the audited journey crosses SPA routes from listing to detail to reader.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for route changes, with a reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-position-aware navigation feedback.
findings.evidence: The 4,632px homepage and long reader retain static chrome; CSS probe found no scroll-state query, scroll progress, or scroll timeline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a lightweight reading/scroll progress affordance or scroll-state-aware compact header on long surfaces.

findings.guidanceId: avoid intrusive interstitial popup content first
findings.summary: Promotions and ads displace the primary content at the start of key journeys.
findings.evidence: Mobile homepage starts with a large migration promotion and external banner; reader starts with two ad blocks before the first chapter panel.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-essential promotions below primary content, cap their size, and keep the chapter visible in the first viewport.

findings.summary: Custom interactive disclosures lack semantic state.
findings.evidence: The library “Filtros” disclosure is a styled div and the mobile menu button has no accessible name or aria-expanded state; no dialog/details/popover primitives were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use button plus aria-expanded/aria-controls or native details for filters, and expose menu state and name.

findings.summary: Non-content chrome overwhelms the catalogue and reader.
findings.evidence: Screenshots show radio chrome, migration artwork and advertising occupying most or all of the first viewport before catalogue/chapter content.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce persistent header/media height and move promotional modules after core content.

findings.summary: Reusable card/filter components only respond to viewport breakpoints.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no container queries or container-type despite cards and controls appearing in multiple grid widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type to reusable regions and adapt cards/filters with @container where their available space, not viewport size, governs layout.

findings.guidanceId: touch target size hover fallback pointer input focus-visible
findings.summary: Several controls have weak touch and keyboard affordances.
findings.evidence: Focus probe found visible controls as small as 17–26px high; the mobile menu and search submit buttons have no accessible text, and Lighthouse button-name failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Give controls at least 44px touch area, accessible names, and consistent :focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: The homepage delays and weakens the primary browse/read task.
findings.evidence: There is no h1 or main landmark; the first mobile viewport is dominated by radio and migration imagery rather than a clear catalogue heading or read/browse action.
findings.suggestedFix: Lead with a descriptive h1 and current titles/chapters, then place secondary radio and announcements later.

findings.summary: Failed media has no useful recovery state.
findings.evidence: HAR records multiple net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_ORB image failures, while the UI shows broken/blank media without retry or explanatory fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle image/network failures with stable placeholders, retry affordances and actionable status messaging.

findings.summary: Loading performance and stability miss Core Web Vitals targets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 8.5s and CLS 0.417 (performance 0.49); the independent layout run measured CLS 0.350.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP content, reserve media space, and defer below-fold/third-party work.

findings.guidanceId: prevent layout shift reserve space CLS aspect-ratio
findings.summary: Images and late content cause large layout shifts.
findings.evidence: All 65 inspected images lack width/height attributes and layout observer recorded two shifts totalling 0.350.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and reserve banner/card slots.

findings.summary: The homepage transfers an excessive image payload through redirect-heavy third parties.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 108 requests and 8.47MB transferred, including 8.11MB images, 102 third-party requests and many 301/302 image redirects; LCP was 8.5s.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove redirecting image URLs, size images at the edge, preload only the LCP image and defer below-fold requests.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable JavaScript and CSS.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 167KiB unused JavaScript and 10KiB unused CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split route-only features and purge unused styles from the production bundle.

findings.summary: Important controls and links lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse button-name failed; the mobile menu/search buttons have no name, home recon found numerous empty-text anchors, and image audit found 8 missing alt values.
findings.suggestedFix: Name every control, remove empty links, label search, and provide meaningful or empty decorative alt text intentionally.

findings.summary: Text labels fail WCAG contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse contrast audit failed, including red “4TA actualizacion” at 3.03:1 and white category labels as low as 2.14:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Use contrast-tested colour tokens meeting 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text/UI.

findings.guidanceId: heading structure landmarks focus order keyboard
findings.summary: Pages lack a logical heading and landmark structure.
findings.evidence: Homepage and library have no h1; DOM inspection found no main element, and headings begin at h3.
findings.suggestedFix: Add main/navigation landmarks and one descriptive h1 per route, with sequential section headings.

findings.summary: Small controls reduce usability under touch and zoom.
findings.evidence: Focus/target probe measured visible links and buttons at 17–26px high, below the recommended 44px touch target, although mobile reflow itself had no overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase hit areas without reducing content density and verify at 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Image dimensions and aspect-ratio reservations are missing.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 65/65 images without width/height, 43 oversized and 27 legacy-format images; Lighthouse unsized-images failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit intrinsic dimensions, responsive srcset/sizes and modern formats from the image pipeline.

findings.guidanceId: crawlable links viewport meta robots descriptive link text
findings.summary: Some links are not crawlable or descriptive.
findings.evidence: Reader DOM contains javascript: navigation/vote links and numerous anchors with empty accessible text; Lighthouse crawlable-anchors failed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href URLs for navigation and buttons for actions; give image-only links accessible names.

findings.guidanceId: canonical hreflang http status robots sitemap noindex seo indexing
findings.summary: Canonical and sitemap signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: No canonical URL was found, and /sitemap.xml returns the generic application HTML rather than an XML sitemap.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate a real XML sitemap and per-route canonical links while keeping successful public routes indexable.

findings.guidanceId: structured data schema.org json-ld open graph social preview metadata
findings.summary: Content pages lack structured data and social previews.
findings.evidence: Representative title detail has no JSON-LD or Open Graph metadata despite representing a named creative work.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org CreativeWork/ComicSeries data and Open Graph/Twitter preview tags.

findings.summary: HTTPS is present but baseline security headers and cookie flags are absent.
findings.evidence: Header audit found no CSP response header, HSTS or nosniff; both analytics cookies were non-Secure and SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS, a restrictive CSP response header, nosniff and Secure/SameSite cookie attributes.

findings.summary: Third-party and analytics exposure is disproportionate.
findings.evidence: Tracker audit found 7 third-party origins including Google Analytics; HAR found 102 third-party requests, and 400-day analytics cookies are set without an observed consent control.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise third parties, defer analytics until appropriate consent, shorten retention and proxy/host essential images responsibly.

findings.summary: Authentication lacks modern credential support.
findings.evidence: Login exposes email/password and Google sign-in but no passkey/WebAuthn affordance; password/email inputs also omit autocomplete tokens. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey sign-in/registration where accounts are supported and retain contextual fallback authentication.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are missing.
findings.evidence: Header audit found no clickjacking control, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy, alongside absent HSTS/CSP.
findings.suggestedFix: Configure CSP frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and HSTS at the server/CDN.

findings.guidanceId: progressive enhancement graceful degradation no javascript baseline fallback
findings.summary: Core content disappears without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability runs report 1% raw/rendered word coverage and an empty #root; both homepage and title detail are JS shells, and the crawler screenshots are blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render or statically generate catalogue, title and chapter navigation, then hydrate enhancements.

findings.guidanceId: http error network failure timeout retry stale data resilient state
findings.summary: Network and asset failures degrade to broken content.
findings.evidence: HAR records ORB-blocked images and aborted requests; screenshots/DOM offer no retry or useful fallback for those failures.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide stable fallbacks, retries and error copy for chapter and promotional media failures.

findings.summary: Images are oversized and insufficiently responsive.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 43 oversized images, 37 without srcset and 27 legacy formats; a single promotional PNG transferred 2.55MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate correctly sized AVIF/WebP variants with srcset/sizes and compress or remove heavy promotional art.

findings.summary: The homepage eagerly fetches substantially more media than the first view needs.
findings.evidence: HAR records 100 image requests and 8.11MB of images, while 36 below-fold images are not lazy loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Lazy-load below-fold media, virtualise long feeds where appropriate and stop loading duplicate/hidden banners.

findings.summary: Third-party media dominates the page budget.
findings.evidence: Third-party requests account for 8.21MB of 8.47MB transferred and 102/108 requests; large banners and radio chrome precede core content.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a route budget, self-host or consolidate essential assets, and defer non-essential media/analytics.

findings.summary: Login and search inputs omit autocomplete assistance.
findings.evidence: Login email/password fields and search inputs report empty autocomplete attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=email and current-password (plus appropriate search semantics) so password managers and autofill can assist users.
